messages:
Maria: Quick postmortem follow-up 1774: need owners for action items and which evals to add.
Tom: Ok, what's the highest impact?
Maria: Top four: 1) compact regression prompt set for fallback, 2) a burst-load replay (mimic spike), 3) KV-cache eviction chaos drill, 4) light CI eval gating (warn first).
Linda: Share sample prompts and I'll sketch the regression harness.
Maria: Scrubbed samples: 
- "Summarize this support ticket and extract action items."
- "From thread history, write a concise follow-up with bullets."
- "Re-rank these results for intent X and give one-line rationale."
Tom: I'll add a k6 scenario: ~200 concurrent users for 60s, sessions with a long mid-sequence gen. I'll include exact command in runbook.
Kevin: For KV eviction: I'll schedule a chaos job in staging that forces aggressive TTLs and rotate caches; add a p99 alert >30% over baseline.
Maria: Proposed owners/timelines: Linda -> regression + CI (non-blocking) in 5 business days; Tom -> load replay + runbook in 7 days; Kevin -> chaos drill + dashboard in 14 days; Maria -> update release checklist in 3 days.
Linda: I'll open a PR under eng-ml/evals/regressions/incident-1772000000 and tag evals:nonblocking. Tests will be strict to avoid flakiness.
Tom: I'll place replay config under eng-ml/replay/incident-1772000000 with a small docker invoker.
Kevin: I'll export a scrubbed long-history trace to include in the regression set so we hit KV behavior.
Maria: CI mode: start warn-only; after 2 clean runs flip to blocking. Agree?
Tom: Agree. Avoid false positives initially.
Linda: Agreed. I'll have the CI post results to the evals dashboard and this thread.
Ops Bot: Reminder: create JIRA tickets and add label incident-1772000000.
Maria: I'll create tickets and link PRs here when ready. Expect initial PRs by EOD.
Cara: Quick UX note: prompt #2 needs tighter constraints to reduce noise; I'll comment on the PR.
Maria: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene Friday in #eng-ml with first-run outcomes.
Tom: :thumbsup:
Linda: On it :rocket:
